spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun; sólet leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish noun.
מִנְחָה is a common noun; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish noun.
Qal passive participle licenses mixed; amasada narrows that to kneading.

notes: Counts, suffixes, construct de, article on santidad/aceite, and shekel only on the seventy match the tokens.
